Dear DigitalOcean Support Team,

I am writing to request a refund for a $10.00 prepayment I made to my account for the Serverless Inference service exercicing the 14-day right to withdraw under the EU Consumer Rights Directive (Directive 2011/83/EU).

My situation:

    I prepaid $10.00 to my account to use the Serverless Inference service.

    I have **not consumed any of this $10.00 balance** — I was using the $5.00 free evaluation credit provided by DigitalOcean to test the service.

    During my evaluation, I found that the rate limits for my current tier (Tier 2) are unacceptably low for my use case—agentic coding, which requires a high volume of API calls. As a result, the service is effectively unusable for my intended purpose. I have requested and been refused a tier increase.

Therefore as an EU-based consumer I wish to exercise my right of withdrawal under the EU Consumer Rights Directive (Directive 2011/83/EU).
